map.：首项 a1=1、公比 r=2、n=10 项：S=1×(2^10-1)/(2-1: : First term a1 = 1, common ratio r = 2, n = 10 terms: S = 1 x (2^10-1)/(2-1) = 1023. That is, 1+2+4+...+512 = 1023.
map.：|r|<1 时无限和 S=a1/(1-r)；如 1+1/2+1/4+…=1/(: : When |r|<1 the infinite sum S = a1/(1-r); for example 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + ... = 1/(1-0.5) = 2, converging to 2.

map.等比求和公式的两个版本？: Two versions of the geometric sum formula?
map.有限项 S=a1(1-r^n)/(1-r)；无限项且 |r|<1 时 S=a1/: Finite terms S = a1(1-r^n)/(1-r); for infinite terms with |r|<1, S = a1/(1-r). An infinite series with |r|>=1 diverges and has no finite sum.
map.公比 r=1 怎么办？: What if the common ratio r = 1?
map.r=1 时分母为 0，公式失效；此时每项相等，和直接为 n×a1。: When r = 1 the denominator is 0 and the formula fails; in that case every term is equal and the sum is simply n x a1.
